## Reviewer 2 Response (Draft)

```
We appreciate Reviewer 2’s request for an ablation comparing rewrite versus naive append. 
Following our preliminary experiments, we will run a “consolidation‑only” baseline in addition to 
MemGPT’s naive append (virtual context paging) and the Structured Memory Rewrite (SMR) variant. 
We expect this design to isolate the effect of the rewrite operation itself.  
Such results will be submitted along with the manuscript by Day 19.
```
**Draft: Notify the reviews team and set internal deadline for manuscript revision.**

## Nudge – GPU Allocation

- 2400 H100 GPU‑hrs approved (May).  
- Plan: ~200 H100 hrs per experimental configuration (rewrite, consolidation, append).  
- 6 configurations → 1200 H100 hrs; remaining budget allows for resubmissions or additional analysis.  
- **Action:** Log usage each night; aim to exhaust by month‑end.

## Overnight Idea

> **MemGPT’s virtual context/paging can serve as a strict “any‑memory” baseline for the rewrite‑vs‑append ablation.**  
> This confirms that the observed gains in the ICLR submission likely stem from reduced cross‑fact interference via consolidation, not the rewrite operation alone. Incorporating this into the ablation will directly satisfy Reviewer 2.
